g.title: PWS_QSP
g.text: Prader-Willi Syndrome — Quantitative Systems Pharmacology map
one convertase, five branches, a harmonic-mean satiety integrator, and a bistable food-seeking state

g.title: cluster_locus
g.text: 1 · imprinted locus 15q11-q13 — one lesion, many silenced genes

g.title: cluster_conv
g.text: 2 · the prohormone convertase node — where one lesion becomes a PATTERN

g.title: cluster_branch
g.text: 3 · the five branches — eps_i alone orders their failure (and their precursor spill)

g.title: cluster_pvn
g.text: 5 · PVN oxytocin — THE RELAY. Melanocortin satiety is IN SERIES with it, not parallel

g.title: cluster_gut
g.text: 6 · gut-brain periphery — and why the ghrelin arm cannot be rescued

g.title: cluster_sat
g.text: 7 · the satiety integrator — a HARMONIC MEAN: the weakest arm rate-limits

g.title: cluster_seek
g.text: 8 · food-seeking — A BISTABLE STATE with a separatrix

g.title: cluster_rew
g.text: 9 · reward, cue sensitization, behaviour and neuropsychiatry

g.title: cluster_energy
g.text: 10 · energy balance and body composition — intake is OFFERED, not chosen

g.title: cluster_air
g.text: 12 · upper airway — THE TWO CLOCKS: growth hormone arrives twice

g.title: cluster_glu
g.text: 13 · glucose, insulin and the metabolic paradox

g.title: cluster_gonad
g.text: 14 · gonadal axis — MKRN3 loss advances the gate, the hypothalamic lesion lowers its amplitude

g.title: cluster_pd
g.text: 17 · drug targets — mapped onto WHICH ARM each one can reach

g.title: cluster_env
g.text: 19 · the food environment — the only intervention that changes which STATES EXIST

g.title: cluster_alg
g.text: 20 · the model's algebra, stated so it can be checked

g.title: ASSAY
g.text: and is EXACTLY blind to PC13

g.title: ANTI
g.text: high eps -> product falls, precursor does NOT accumulate
low eps -> precursor accumulates, product barely falls
=> precursor:product ratio cannot grade the branches that matter

g.title: OXTR->BEH
g.text: same receptor as the drive term

g.title: SERIES
g.text: => MC4R agonism is bounded above by

g.title: RI
g.text: by this same relay => PWS is FUNCTIONALLY
normal receptors, at no extra parameter

g.title: HARM
g.text: a harmonic mean CANNOT be rescued by its healthy terms:
normalizing ALL FOUR non-oxytocin arms moves SAT from

g.title: SADDLE
g.text: above it the LOW STATE DOES NOT EXIST
and no dose can hold a state the

g.title: THRESH
g.text: the latched upper state disappears only at
SAT >= 0.77, i.e. an oxytocin-arm gain of 2.4x.
Carbetocin at its analytic optimum gives 1.49x.
SHORTFALL 1.61x — a STATE problem, not a potency problem.

g.title: SURPL
g.text: a NORMAL intake is a SURPLUS when
expenditure is low. Weight gain therefore

g.title: WINDOW
g.text: THE WINDOW IS EMERGENT, NOT FITTED
AHI peaks at WEEKS 4-8 then falls below baseline.
Vulnerability multiplies the WINDOW, not the plateau:
=> polysomnography before, and 6-8 weeks after, starting GH;
do not start GH during a respiratory infection.

g.title: PARAD
g.text: THE PARADOX IS ONE PARAMETER, NOT TWO:
the convertase that starves the satiety arms also
throttles proinsulin processing. Model at MATCHED

g.title: NONPR
g.text: Both signs come from the SAME deletion.

g.title: CANCEL
g.text: AND muscle tone (better). Modelled, the two
NEARLY CANCEL — 12.5 vs 12.7 deg at 14 y for
+18 cm of height. Which is what the trials found.

g.title: PULS
g.text: surrogate for daily somatropin needs a potency
factor < 1 to land on the observed +1.5 to +2 SDS
of IGF-1 — pulsatile GH is more IGF-1-efficient
per unit AUC than a flat exposure.

g.title: ORTHO
g.text: THE PANEL IS NEARLY ORTHOGONAL TO ITS BIOMARKER:
The agents that move the ghrelin biomarker most move the
endpoint least. Octreotide is the extreme case, and it also
suppresses the one axis PWS already lacks.

g.title: FIXED
g.text: DCCR's efficacy and its hyperglycaemia are the SAME
channel in two tissues, so their ratio is fixed once by
EDZ50/EDZI50 = 0.68. No dose separates them; only a

g.title: OPT
g.text: = 1.21 ng/mL; 3.2 mg TID -> 2.06 ng/mL (98% of E(C*))
The useful range is bounded on BOTH sides, from V1a
cross-activation alone and no dose-specific parameter.

g.title: BIMOD
g.text: THE ENDPOINT MAY BE THE WRONG SUMMARY:
because SEEK is bistable, HQ-CT response should be
BIMODAL (latched vs not) rather than shifted. A trial
powered on MEAN HQ-CT can succeed while every patient

g.title: EARLY
g.text: once a patient has latched, restoring STANDARD
management removes the fat but NOT the state
The cheap moment is before they ever get there.

g.title: TRIAL
g.text: every agent in cluster 17 was tested in patients with a
STABLE FOOD-SECURE ENVIRONMENT as an entry condition.
In a free-access environment the low state does not exist,
so those effect sizes must not be extrapolated to families

g.title: ALG1
g.text: Eq. A product loss of branch i
L rises with eps; R FALLS with eps.

g.title: ALG2
g.text: This is why plasma and CSF 'oxytocin'
studies in PWS disagree with each other.

g.title: ALG4
g.text: three fixed points at food-secure inputs;
the LOW one is annihilated at CUE* = 0.58.

g.title: ALG5
g.text: fat is the BUFFER, lean follows a developmental
target => energy is exactly conserved and PWS's
lean deficit is DERIVED, not imposed.

g.title: ALG6
g.text: airway: two first-order clocks on one output
=> a non-monotone AHI with a peak at weeks 4-8.

g.title: ALG7
g.text: WHAT IS CALIBRATED vs WHAT IS DERIVED
calibrated to trial outcomes: the ghrelin arm weight
DERIVED from structure: the phase sequence, the airway
window, the inverted carbetocin dose-response, the
prediction, and the 2.4x oxytocin-arm gain a next-
generation agonist would have to reach.
